notes: Cluster-wide totals from /api/overview use no labels and are distinct metric names from the per-queue series under /api/queues to keep label dimensionality consistent per metric name. message_stats.* fields are absent until the corresponding activity has occurred on the node/queue, so they are marked required=false. Per-queue and per-node metrics carry the identifying labels (vhost+queue, node) from their source objects; no unbounded or ID-like labels (e.g. connection/channel IDs, timestamps) are used.
